13-## Eight rules
14-
15:1. **Tokens only.** No literal colours in components; every colour is a token so both themes hold. Lanes and causes keep their colours everywhere (donut, trace, Pareto swatch, legend).
16-2. **Two faces.** IBM Plex Sans for UI text (400/500/600). JetBrains Mono for everything that is an identifier or a number: ids, event kinds, tokens, USD-eq, minutes, timestamps, chips, table numerics (`tabular-nums`, right-aligned).
17-3. **One scale.** Sizes 11, 12, 14 (body), 15 (h3), 22 (page title). Spacing 4, 8, 12, 18, 28. Page max width 1180 px; rail 220 px.
18-4. **Every page starts the same way.** `.eyebrow` breadcrumb in mono orange (`Products › observatory-v1 › mission e194b9e3`), an `h2` title, a mono muted subtitle on the right with the facts (system, template, elapsed, window). Then KPI tiles, then the table or board.
19-5. **KPI tiles say one number each**: mono value with its unit in small muted text, a plain-language caption below. Red value only for a bad number (tokens burnt in waste, cards needing a decision).
20-6. **Tables are the lists.** `.lib` box, uppercase 11 px headers, 10 px cells, the name column bold with a mono small line under it, numbers right-aligned in mono, a state chip, and a 90 px mini donut as the last column where there is lane data. Rows are clickable (hover tint); rows without a record are dimmed, never hidden.

22-8. **Surfaces are quiet.** Background `--bg`, panels `--surface` with a 1 px `--border` and 10 px radius, no shadows except the brand mark. Dark mode is not an inversion: the tokens are tuned per theme; keep 4.5:1 for text everywhere.
